concepts.prompt: Create a 1536x1024 high fidelity flat full-screen UI design mockup. This must look like an ACTUAL FUNCTIONAL USER INTERFACE found on a device INSIDE the Warhammer 40,000 universe, designed by the Adeptus Mechanicus for Imperial personnel. Not a Warhammer fan website, not a themed modern SaaS dashboard, not a game HUD pasted over art. The attached image is approved direction A; make a distinct variation maintaining its green phosphor console credibility. Austere utilitarian sacred industrial computing: dark #000a04, luminous #58e284 strokes, pale mint highlights, dim green readouts, thin horizontal CRT scanlines, measured phosphor bloom and residual ghost traces, subtle worn CRT nonuniformity. Functional ruled panel divisions, calibration ticks, channel numbers, compact classification stamps, a SMALL cog-skull or aquila authenticity seal, archival identifiers. Dense but legible, disciplined alignment, controls large enough to touch. Ornament must have a functional/institutional purpose. NO pictures of couches or rooms, NO house image or floorplan illustration, NO cathedral arch borders, NO decorative gothic tracery, NO holographic floating skull mascot, NO huge brand logo, NO rusty metal bezel rendered around screen, NO 3D perspective, NO desktop monitor photograph, NO rainbow colors, NO rounded bubbly iOS switches. Blackletter may appear only sparingly in small masthead; most text technical monospaced or segmented instrument lettering. The actual UI controls a home: keep labels practical beneath restrained in-world section names. Tabs HOME / FLOOR PLAN / MEDIA / YARD / ALEXANDRIA. Scenes Living room on / Good night / All lamps off / Pause music. Living Room channels: Couch, Chez Lounge, Pappasan, Window lamp, Grow lamp. Library: Torch front, Torch back, Fireplace. Outside: Outdoor 1, Outdoor 2, Sunset schedule, Rain delay. Climate current68F target70F plus/minus; Icarus printer72%, time1h14m, nozzle220C. A large media panel VOX-CANTICLE, tiny source SPOTIFY, Late Again by aimless, The Deli. Preserve a large green monochrome dithered album-art background in that panel; use an abstract nocturnal city illustration without making it decorative wallpaper for whole screen. Functional play/pause/next, progress and volume. Album art is the ONLY pictorial content. Real home labels, not endless nonsense faux code. Tiny footer operational status can be IN NOMINE OMNISSIAH / LINK VERIFIED. Top margin concept label: A1 / PATTERN IX — DUTY TERMINAL. Closest refined evolution of reference A. Pragmatic naval bridge cogitator: rectangular thin ruled panel grid, small offset clipped corners, tightly restrained header DOMUS COGITATOR / PATTERN IX. Left narrow instrument rail with clock, cog seal and system load. Wide central media artwork panel across upper third; below it scenes/climate/printer instruments; bottom three room control columns. Replace pill toggles with luminous two-position rectangular ENABLED / STANDBY latch fields and small numbered signal indicators. A beautiful disciplined, confident monochrome operating system. A little blackletter only in compact masthead. Strongest balance of usable home UI and real Imperial technology.
